rules.description: Kernel Kit product path captures advisory browser Web Locks exclusive/shared coordination posture and carries it into handoff/support evidence without claiming fairness or lifecycle recovery.

rules.description: Kernel Kit support-bundle replay now machine-checks supplied compact report artifacts against evidence-ledger proof paths instead of only naming expected outputs.
rules.reason: The next risk after an evidence ledger is false replayability: a future session can have artifact names without a bounded machine check that supplied reports satisfy required proof fields.

rules.description: Kernel Kit support-bundle evidence checkpoint reads the compact JSON artifacts named by the ledger and validates their contents without claiming authenticity or executing commands.
rules.reason: The previous checkpoint could validate supplied report objects, but a future session still needed a bounded file-backed verifier to catch missing or malformed compact artifacts before replay claims widen.

rules.description: Kernel Kit support-bundle evidence seal now hashes package-retained artifact files and requires verify_release.py to bind those rows to the final RELEASE-MANIFEST.json.
rules.reason: File-backed checkpoints can read artifacts, but the next package-risk is shipping a zip whose release manifest no longer retains or matches the evidence files named by the ledger.

rules.description: Release archive verifier independently parses zip-contained package-evidence artifacts so a stale artifact cannot pass merely because the seal rows and manifest hashes agree.
rules.reason: Package evidence seal rows can be correct for the bytes they saw, but verify_release.py must re-check the archive contents themselves before a linked zip is trusted.
